findings.title: Findings converge on the loop's two-bucket failure classification (D9/D10/D13)
findings.why_it_matters: Two dispositions (retry at 5 s forever / park) leave auth-maybe-transient, permanent non-auth, deterministic 1009, programming errors and never-connected misconfig each needing a local patch.
findings.recommended: A: Re-evaluate the failure classification before addressing Findings 2-6
findings.choice_reason: Re-evaluation settled four dispositions (Propagate/Fast/Slow/Park); user asked for prior art, then chose a 5 min slow tier over 60 s after the fail2ban analysis, and chose 3x60 s auth retries after a prior success.

findings.title: auth_invalid park leaves Hassette permanently idle, invisible to the add-on Watchdog, and HA's token check is clock-sensitive
findings.why_it_matters: A false auth_invalid (clock skew at HA boot) freezes apps indefinitely with no supervisor-visible signal.

findings.title: Permanent non-auth failures retried every 5 s forever
findings.why_it_matters: 401/403 from proxies or ban lists are hit ~17k/day; config typos hidden at WARNING.
findings.recommended: A: named permanent classes retry on a slow fixed interval

findings.title: Deterministic oversized get_states (1009) plus D14 put sustained load on a recovering HA
findings.why_it_matters: HA serializes a 16 MiB+ payload about every 6 s indefinitely.
findings.recommended: A: long backoff cap for repeated 1009s; revert D14 to StateProxy-specific constants

findings.title: D9 catch-all swallows strict-lifecycle and programming errors; traceback dedupe key too coarse
findings.why_it_matters: Strict-mode transition bugs hang tests instead of failing them.
findings.recommended: A: named propagate set; dedupe on (type, innermost file:line)

findings.title: D6/D7 remove fail-fast for a mistyped base_url
findings.why_it_matters: The most common first-run failure loops quietly at WARNING.
findings.recommended: A: never-connected periodic summary at ERROR with the base_url hint

findings.title: A flapping upstream defeats D11's log bound and forces repeated full resyncs
findings.why_it_matters: Each successful-but-short connection triggers resync, bus events and INFO logs; backoff bounds only attempts.
findings.recommended: A: carry backoff across drops after a short-lived connection
findings.chosen: A: carry backoff across drops after a short-lived connection
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut (recommended option) and listed to the user.

findings.title: D12 hold-in-CONNECTING has no deadline, no visible reason, and an undefined reset clock
findings.why_it_matters: A wedged HA leaves Hassette waiting invisibly; reset clock ambiguity changes backoff behavior.
findings.recommended: A: ready reason + periodic log; STOPPING/FINAL_WRITE fail the attempt; reset clock = CONNECTED; no deadline
findings.chosen: A: ready reason + periodic log; STOPPING/FINAL_WRITE fail the attempt; reset clock = CONNECTED; no deadline
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut (recommended option) and listed to the user.

findings.title: D12 does not say where HA-boot events are dropped
findings.why_it_matters: dispatch_hass_event has no state gate today; the drop has no stated home.
findings.chosen: Drop in dispatch_hass_event while not CONNECTED; homeassistant_started consumed by the gate; result messages unaffected.

findings.title: wait_initial_connection / _first_connection_attempt_done_event lose meaning under an infinite loop
findings.why_it_matters: Produces a misleading WARNING on slow boots; primitive has no remaining purpose.
findings.recommended: A: delete the event and wait_initial_connection
findings.chosen: A: delete the event and wait_initial_connection
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut (recommended option) and listed to the user.

findings.title: D12 names the wrong gate; Api.get_config cannot run during the hold
findings.why_it_matters: A naive build calling Api.get_config would never leave CONNECTING.
findings.chosen: App calls blocked by Api's is_connected check; the hold's get_config goes through WebsocketService.send_and_wait.

findings.title: D10 lists two new transitions but not the full table
findings.why_it_matters: Existing writers' interaction with new edges left to the build.
findings.chosen: Write out the full post-change WS_VALID_TRANSITIONS table with writers; test every pair.

findings.title: Apps keep running on a STALE cache; per-call failures persisted unbounded
findings.why_it_matters: Audience assumption: long unattended outages. Thousands of persisted error rows from app jobs.

Removing ServiceWatcher leaves no watchdog for a wedged loop phase
Shutdown during backoff and park needs wait_for(shutdown_event) and explicit session close
